# GlobalSecurity.org

> A comprehensive resource for military, defense, and geopolitical security intelligence covering global conflicts and defense policy.

GlobalSecurity.org provides security research, military analysis, and defense intelligence with coverage of international conflicts including Israel-Palestine, Iran, and U.S. defense matters. The site offers both free content and premium subscription access for institutional and individual researchers.

## Key Topics

- Military intelligence
- Defense policy
- Geopolitical conflicts
- Israel-Hamas conflict
- Iran security
- U.S. defense
- Security research
- Situation reports
- Federation of American Scientists
- John Pike
- Premium access
- Institutional licenses
- Copyright policy
- Content reuse
- Defense analysis
